title: Forward Deployed Intern
job_description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth. About the role Learn how a global trading business really works, and build the AI tools that make it faster. As a Forward Deployed Intern, you spend six months inside our business. You sit with the teams that buy, sell and move industrial materials, learn how their work really happens, and build tools that make it faster, with AI at the core. You work alongside our product and engineering team, with a mentor who reviews your work and helps you grow. This is not a shadowing internship: you take on real problems, ship real tools, and see them used every day. What you will do Learn the business Join our sales, procurement, logistics and finance teams and understand how a trade works from request to delivery. Spot where people lose time to manual work. Build , Measure & Share Build automations, small agents, scripts and dashboards with AI tools such as Claude. Ship first versions quickly and improve them with feedback from the people who use them. Track whether what you built saves time or prevents mistakes. Decide with your mentor what to improve and what to stop. Document what you built so others can use it. Show your work in demos to the team. What success looks like Several tools or automations in daily use by our teams Measured time savings for at least one team Clear documentation others can build on A solid understanding of how a global trade works end to end What you bring You are enrolled in a degree in computer science, engineering, business informatics or a similar field. You can code, for example in Python or JavaScript, and use AI tools in your daily work. Real curiosity about how businesses work, not only about technology. You communicate clearly and like working with people from other backgrounds. You can commit to six months full-time in Berlin. Fluent English. German is a plus. We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

title: CAE AI Intern
job_description: Company Description SimProof is a specialized software company focused on making engineering simulations more reliable and traceable. This role offers exposure to real-world simulation problems and practical applications of AI in engineering verification. Currently enrolled in or recently completed a degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, computational engineering, computer science, or a related field. title: FY27 PhD Internship: Data-Centric AI for End-to-End Autonomous Driving - 6 months, Munich, Unterschleißheim, Germany
job_description: Company Qualcomm Technologies GmbH Job Area Interns Group, Interns Group > Workstudy Intern General Summary PhD Internship: Data-Centric AI for End-to-End Autonomous Driving Location: Munich / Unterschleißheim, Germany Duration: 6 months Area: Autonomous Driving, End-to-End AI, Vision-Language Models, Data-Centric AI We are looking for a highly motivated PhD student to join our AI Systems team in Munich and conduct research on automated data curation for end-to-end autonomous driving systems . Modern end-to-end driving models depend heavily on the quality, diversity, and relevance of their training data. Large-scale driving datasets, however, contain substantial redundancy while rare and safety-critical situations remain difficult to identify systematically. The goal of this internship is to develop data-centric AI techniques that automatically identify model weaknesses and translate observed real world driving failures into improved training datasets . The work will move beyond general data selection towards fine-grained, model-aware data curation using trajectory and action information, multimodal representations, and potentially Vision-Language Models (VLMs). Your Profile Minimum Qualifications Currently enrolled in a PhD program in Computer Science, Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, or a related technical field. Strong knowledge of machine learning and deep learning. Experience with PyTorch and Python. Experience in at least one of: Computer vision Autonomous driving Multimodal/Vision-Language Models Robotics Ability to develop and evaluate research ideas independently. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Preferred Qualifications Research experience in end-to-end autonomous driving, behavior prediction, trajectory prediction, or robotics. Experience with VLMs/VLM evaluation, foundation models, or multimodal representation learning. Experience working with large-scale datasets and data-selection or active-learning techniques. Familiarity with closed-loop simulation or autonomous-driving evaluation. Publications or demonstrated research experience at major machine-learning, computer-vision, or robotics venues such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, CoRL, or ICRA. What You Will Gain This internship offers the opportunity to conduct applied research at the intersection of autonomous driving, multimodal foundation models, and data-centric AI . The research has the potential to contribute directly to scalable data-flywheel systems in production for autonomous driving , connecting vehicle evaluation, failure discovery, intelligent data selection, and model retraining. title: Intern in the CAVES & PANGAEA Team - Machine Learning Development
job_description: Location EAC, Porz-Wahn, Germany Our team and mission The CAVES and PANGAEA team specialises in training programmes that equip astronauts and mission developers with scientific, expeditionary and behavioural skills. The group’s primary output is focused around two training programmes, CAVES, a course that uses natural cave systems for expeditionary and human behavioural and performance training, and PANGAEA, a course for geological and astrobiological field training. Complementary to their training goals, these programmes are used as research and development platforms to advance several of ESA’s technological, scientific and operational areas. One such tool developed for PANGAEA and future missions is the PANGAEA Analytical Toolset. This comprises the Mineralogical Database (MinDB), a curated collection of information on all the minerals found on the Moon, Mars and in meteorites, and the Machine Learning (ML) software that combines deep learning multi-class and multi-label classification algorithms analysing fused multi-modal spectroscopic measurements, enabling a significant accuracy increase of mineral and rock recognition. Further information on PANGAEA and CAVES programmes can be found on the following websites: https://www.esa.int/Science_Exploration/Human_and_Robotic_Exploration/CAVES_and_Pangaea/What_is_PANGAEA https://www.esa.int/Science_Exploration/Human_and_Robotic_Exploration/CAVES_and_Pangaea/What_is_CAVES We are looking for internships to start throughout 2027. title: Intern in the XR Lab
job_description: Location EAC, Porz-Wahn, Germany Our team and mission ​​The XR Lab at the European Astronaut Centre explores how Extended Reality technologies can enhance human spaceflight and future space exploration. Our work spans astronaut training, mission simulation, operational support, hardware development, and exploration mission design. By integrating virtual, augmented, and mixed reality technologies into spaceflight activities, we help develop innovative solutions for crews, engineers, and operators, while supporting the preparation of future missions beyond Earth orbit. The use of XR for training at EAC includes spacewalks, robotics, human anatomy and training technology demonstrators onboard the ISS. ​ ​Within the XR Lab, this opportunity is to further develop Extended Reality tools based on Unreal Engine for astronauts. This would specifically focus on preliminary work for projects using some Meta Quest 3 headsets onboard the International Space Station. In this context, the work combines extended reality development with machine learning techniques to improve interaction, perception, environment understanding, data interpretation, or context-aware assistance in constrained operational environments. The work may involve prototyping, testing, and refining methods that can increase robustness and usability for astronaut applications. ​ ​You will collaborate closely with engineers in the XR-Lab and experts in the European Astronaut Centre to contribute to ongoing developments that connect software engineering, human-centred design, and ISS Operations.
